incidents.name: Punk Protocol pool re-initialization
incidents.notes: The Punk pool's initialize() carried neither access control nor an initialized guard, so the attacker re-initialized it with their own forge_ address and then called withdrawToForge() to sweep the pooled stablecoins.

sources.ref: onchain review: the single attack tx touches all three sibling pools - Punk USDC 0x3bc6aa2d (used here as victim), Punk USDT 0x1f3b04c8c96a31c7920372ffa95371c80a4bfb0d and Punk DAI 0x929cb86046e421abf7e1e02de7836742654d49d6 - which share the same flawed code; 0x3bc6aa2d created 2021-08-02 by 0xe36cc0432619247ab12f1cdd19bb3e7a24a7f47c, not by attack sender 0x1d5a5640. lossUsd 8,950,000 is the protocol-wide figure (rekt); ~$4.95m was later returned
